integrity: A complete analytic Fourier proof and standalone exact-symbolic identity checker are supplied; finite checker samples are not used as infinite proofs. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The threshold classifies only the unshifted, non-zero-inflated one-parameter symmetric Poisson–Lindley law; no inference, multivariate, or self-decomposability statement is claimed. Related 2022 full texts remain incompletely accessible, so historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp compound-Poisson threshold for the symmetric Poisson–Lindley distribution
